name: Voidcurrent Crossing
introDiscord: A currentless gap cuts through Starfall Trench. Glimmer's old trail marks suggest it attempted navigation here. The results are... interpretive.
introTwitch: A currentless gap cuts through Starfall Trench. Glimmer's old trail marks suggest it attempted navigation here. The results are... interpretive.

voidcurrent-crossing-approach.prompt: Three paths cross water that refuses to move.

left.message: A Voidcurrent Skate glides through water that supposedly has no current. Show-off.

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary hangs motionless in open water.

forward.message:
Shizuki's tonic sits beneath a glowing Glimmer mark shaped vaguely like an arrow.

Shizuki added: "Glimmer says this means forward. I think."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and trust Glimmer's artistic interpretation of directional signage.

voidcurrent-crossing-depths.prompt: Three routes split beneath increasingly abstract glowing arrows.

left.message: A cometglass seam gleams beneath the still water.

right.message: A Voidcurrent Skate emerges from behind one of Glimmer's arrows.

forward.message:
A Berry rests beside a glowing spiral.

Shizuki wrote: "Asked Glimmer for directions. Glimmer drew circle. We have been here before."

left.message: Shizuki's tonic is marked by one final Glimmer arrow. It points in four directions.
left.fullHpMessage: The medicine stays untouched. The arrow remains philosophically correct.

right.message: A star-chart coffer floats perfectly still.

forward.message:
"A Voidcurrent Skate silently crosses the final route."

BOSS:

boss-antechamber.name: Currentless Expanse
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Glimmer mark suddenly points toward the same enormous shadow.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every Glimmer mark suddenly points toward the same enormous shadow.

That is either excellent navigation or terrible news.

Use /yes to enter the Currentless Expanse or /no to question Glimmer's credentials elsewhere.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every Glimmer mark suddenly points toward the same enormous shadow.

That is either excellent navigation or terrible news.

Use !yes to enter the Currentless Expanse or !no to question Glimmer's credentials elsewhere.
bossRetreatText: You retreat. Glimmer's old arrows offer no useful commentary.

boss.revealText:
A vast Skate unfolds across the motionless water.

Eventide Skate reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Expanse settles.

One tiny Glimmer arrow illuminates the correct exit.

It knew all along.

Probably."
